title: Tour: Dashboard
blurb: Your business at a glance: leads, deals, appointments and messages.

steps.title: Your widgets
steps.body: Each box is a widget showing one number or chart, such as new leads, pipeline value or unread messages. Hover over a chart for the detail.

steps.title: Pick a date range
steps.body: Use the date picker at the top to change the period every widget shows. Luubu remembers your choice next time you log in.

steps.title: Switch dashboards
steps.body: You can have more than one dashboard, for example one for sales and one for the front desk. Use the dashboard menu at the top left to switch or create a new one.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Click the pencil icon at the top right to edit. You can then add, move, resize or remove widgets.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Add a widget to your dashboard** from the Guide.
